verdict.rationale: An online state business-filing and records service could plausibly offer API credentials, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a standard username/password Online Account and data subscriptions, with nothing on API keys, tokens, or scoped least-privilege credentials for agents. Probes also show the public surfaces bot-walled behind Radware CAPTCHA.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
